cast: SPINE thesis. Refrain: "Copy it.". Features: dario, the-posted-promise, the-first-copier, the-young-builder. A careful builder ties a weight to himself in front of everybody, writing on his workshop door a promise that names the exact moment he will stop. Then he does the thing nobody expects: he publishes the plans, so any competitor can take the method and use it by morning. For years nobody does, and it costs him customers, people, and one public stop on the most expensive day of his life. Then a customer asks a rival why his door is blank.
